---
name: Feature request
about: Suggest an idea or feature for TradeAgent
title: '[FEATURE] <Short description of feature>'
labels: ['enhancement']
assignees: ''
---

## 🚀 Feature Description
A clear and concise description of the requested feature or capability.

## 🎯 Problem / Motivation
Is your feature request related to a problem or limitation in the current system? (e.g. "I'm always frustrated when...")

## 💡 Proposed Solution
Describe the solution or implementation you'd like to see. Include proposed agent roles, prompt modifications, data sources, or execution changes if applicable.

## 🛡️ Risk & Safety Considerations
How does this feature impact:
- Capital protection and `RiskGate`?
- Broker interaction or order execution?
- API rate limits and token spend?

## 🔄 Alternatives Considered
A clear and concise description of any alternative solutions or features you've considered.

## ℹ️ Additional Context
Add any other context, screenshots, academic papers, or diagrams about the feature request here.
